headlines.title: CSX (CSX) Q3 Earnings Report Preview: What To Look For
headlines.summary: Freight rail services provider CSX (NASDAQ:CSX) will be announcing earnings results this Wednesday afternoon. Here’s what investors should know.

headlines.title: CSX Stock And North American Rail Shares Facing A Diesel Margin Test
headlines.summary: Energy markets are caught between a short 60-day easing of Russia sanctions and ongoing conflict risks that keep diesel prices on edge, and freight rail and intermodal stocks sit right in that crossfire. That mix creates a window where pricing, volumes and costs could all shift in ways investors care about. This article walks through three North American freight rail and intermodal transport stocks that appear most exposed to this news right now.

headlines.title: Unlocking Q3 Potential of CSX (CSX): Exploring Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
headlines.summary: Evaluate the expected performance of CSX (CSX) for the quarter ended September 2026, looking beyond the conventional Wall Street top-and-bottom-line estimates and examining some of its key metrics for better insight.

headlines.title: Is CSX (CSX) Below Fair Value Following COO Retirement And Third Quarter Earnings Focus?
headlines.summary: CSX (CSX) heads into its October 21 third quarter earnings report with several moving parts in focus, including a chief operating officer retirement, options market activity, and a recent minor derailment incident. Recent headlines around the COO transition, options market activity and the minor Rockville derailment sit against a backdrop where CSX’s share price has eased over the past month and quarter, yet still shows strong momentum.

headlines.title: How CSX’s (CSX) COO Retirement and Direct-Report Shift to the CEO May Influence Investors
headlines.summary: CSX Corporation recently announced that Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer Mike Cory retired from his role on October 12, 2026, and will remain through May 8, 2027, to provide transition support while senior operations leaders Doug Ryhorchuk and Casey Albright now report directly to CEO Steve Angel.

description: CSX Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides rail-based freight transportation services in the United States and Canada. It operates through two segments: rail and trucking. The company offers rail services; and transportation of intermodal containers and trailers, as well as other transportation services, such as rail-to-truck transfers and bulk commodity operations. It also transports chemicals, agricultural and food products, minerals, automotive, forest products, fertilizers, and metals and equipment; and coal, coke, and iron ore to electricity-generating power plants, steel manufacturers, and industrial plants, as well as exports coal to deep-water port facilities. In addition, the company provides intermodal services through a network of approximately 30 terminals transporting manufactured consumer goods in containers; and drayage services, including the pickup and delivery of intermodal shipments. It serves the automotive industry with distribution centers and storage locations, as well as connects non-rail served customers through transferring products, such as plastics and ethanol from rail to trucks. The company operates approximately 20,000 route mile rail network, which serves various population centers in 26 states east of the Mississippi River, the District of Columbia, and the Canadian provinces of Ontario and Quebec, as well as owns 3400 locomotives. It serves production and distribution facilities through track connections. CSX Corporation was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida.
